final: SELECT frequency, freq_sum, freq_sum - overall_avg FROM (SELECT frequency, SUM(disp_counts.cnt) as freq_sum, AVG(SUM(disp_counts.cnt)) OVER () as overall_avg FROM (SELECT account_id, frequency, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM (SELECT disp.account_id, account.frequency FROM disp INNER JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id) GROUP BY account_id, frequency) as disp_counts GROUP BY frequency) WHERE freq_sum > overall_avg ORDER BY frequency
